plans.note: Quote is from the home page's comparison table. Pricing page: Dine-in plan ₹500 per month or ₹5,000 per year (yearly saves ₹1,000); 'Your own restaurant ordering app for delivery and pickup is a one-time setup of ₹5,000.' The pricing page itself does not say in words that the ₹500 plan is required beside the app; the comparison table pairs them. No per-order fee stated; GST not stated.
